job.title: Tower Crane Operator/Dogman
job.description:
The team at Network Recruitment Group specialise in placing skilled, motivated and upstanding construction workers on commercial construction projects across the Perth metropolitan area.

We are currently looking for experienced Tower Crane Operators and Dogman for various upcoming commercial construction sites.

To be considered, you will have the following:
  • High Risk Licence - CT/DG
  • White Card
  • Experience with luffing or hammerhead tower cranes - is a must!
  • Experience on commercial construction sites is essential
  • 2 x Site Managers as referees
  • Ability to pass a Drug & Alcohol Test

  • A commitment to OH&S

If you meet the above requirements and would like to be considered for these roles, hit the "APPLY" button now, and upload your up to date resume. For more information please contact us on 08 9380 9727.

job.title: Dogman
job.description:
The team at Network Recruitment Group specialise in placing skilled, motivated and upstanding construction workers on commercial construction projects across the Perth metropolitan area and greater Western Australia. 

We are currently looking for experienced Dogmen to be part of the tower crane crew for long-term and short term projects starting up.

These roles offer the opportunity to work on prominent construction projects with well-established commercial builders.

You will have the following:
  • Experience dogging tower cranes on commercial construction projects
  • Ability to communicate clearly with partnered crane operator
  • Current High-Risk Licence with either: DG / RB / RI / RA
  • Tower Crane licence highly desirable
  • White Card
  • Available to work Monday through to Saturday
  • A good level of physical fitness
  • The ability to pass random drug & alcohol test
If you meet the above requirements and wish to be considered for these roles, hit the "APPLY" button now and upload your up to date resume. 
For more information please contact us on 08 9380 9727.

job.title: Skilled Construction Labourer
job.description:
The team at Network Recruitment Group specialise in recruiting quality staff for commercial builders in Western Australia. We are searching for experienced traffic controllers/labourers for short & long-term roles on commercial construction projects across the Perth Metropolitan area (no FIFO). 

To be considered, you will have the following:
  • Construction White Card (Essential)
  • MUST be willing to undertake labouring duties on site
  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with stakeholders, colleagues and general public in a professional manner 
  • Be able to coordinate and direct delivery vehicles 
  • Ability to pass a Drug & Alcohol Test
  • A commitment to WHS
  • Additional High Risk qualifications and tickets will be highly regarded:
    • Hoist Operation - (Personnel and Materials)
    • Telehandler
    • Dogman
    • Forklift
    • Traffic Management 
Benefits:
  • Competitive and weekly pay
  • Career growth opportunities with reputable companies in the industry
  • Casual and ongoing positions available!
If the above sounds like you and you are interested in the work we have available please click APPLY NOW! If you have any questions regarding the listed position please call us on 08 9380 9727 or email your query to info@networkrecruitmentgroup.com.au.
